user.title: ista Online
user.description: Log in with your istaonline.dk credentials. The consumer id (cons_id) is discovered automatically after login.

meter.title: Select meter
meter.description: Several meters/consumer ids were found on your account. Choose which one this integration should use.

manual.title: Enter consumer id manually
manual.description: No consumer id could be found automatically. Enter it manually (found in your istaonline account/URL).

data_description.cons_id: Found in your istaonline account/URL. Used for the CSV export.

history.title: How much history?
history.description: Choose which period the import should start from for consumer id {cons_id}. The list is what your ista account itself offers — pick the oldest to import everything. The import may take a moment.

data_description.from_period: You can always import further back later from the integration's options.

prices.title: Prices per heating year
prices.description:
Imported {days} days from {meters} meters for consumer id {cons_id} ({meter_type}).

Enter the unit price (DKK) for each heating year. A heating year runs from 1 May to 30 April, and the price is the same for every meter. Leave a year at 0 if you do not know the price — no cost is then calculated for that year, and you can fill it in later from the options.

prices.title: Prices per heating year

meter_names.title: Name the meters
meter_names.description: Give each meter a name. The name is used both for the meter's device in Home Assistant and for its statistics. The field label is the meter number.

history.title: Import more history
history.description: Pick an earlier start period to import more years. Data already imported is kept — this only adds to it.

abort.no_meters: There are no meters to name yet — wait for the first fetch to complete
abort.no_periods: Could not read the period list from istaonline.dk
